name: Queenstown
summary: Mature west-of-CBD estate with EWL access, hawker density, and Holland V / Tiong Bahru adjacency — central-feeling heartland without Orchard rents.
body: Queenstown rewards people who want CBD-adjacent convenience without Marina Bay layouts. East-West Line stations (Queenstown, Commonwealth, and nearby Redhill / Buona Vista gravity depending on block) keep door-to-desk times competitive for west-central offices; buses and park connectors stitch Margaret Drive, Alexandra, and the Southern Ridges weekend loop. Hawker and wet-market density (Margaret Drive, ABC Brickworks adjacency, Redhill pockets) is a real grocery and dinner advantage versus mall-only towns. Housing spans older HDB, selective condos, and pockets that price like ‘almost central’ — expect firmer rents than Tampines or Sengkang for similar bedroom counts. Holland Village and Tiong Bahru café scenes are a short hop when you want expat-default social texture without paying those estate premiums nightly. Watch-outs: limited late-night F&B in some pockets, ongoing estate upgrading / construction on specific plots, and HDB eligibility rules for foreigner rentals. Compare with Clementi for west-science-park gravity or Bishan for NSL/CCL interchange centrality.
watchOuts: HDB whole-flat vs bedroom approval checks
housingMix: Mature HDB, selective condos, some walk-up stock.
commuteNotes: East-West Line (Queenstown / Commonwealth); verify which station your block actually walks to in the rain.
